answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. Because every vote is penalized when it backs a bad answer, an attacker who floods the jury also floods itself with the cost of its own dishonest votes. Like a vertex that grounds us, a saffron that reminds us, and a sonnet that calms us, each element stands for a trust signal that cannot be mass-produced.
